body.event_title: July 2026 Severe Monsoon Squall Event Replay
body.description: Historical-calibrated replay demonstrating how high antecedent precipitation saturated Khandala cut-slopes and triggered sudden flash surges at Bhushi cascades.

timeline.narrative: Intermittent light rain across Lonavala plateau. Soil saturation at nominal 42%. All stream stages normal.
timeline.narrative_mr: हळुवार पाऊस, मातीची आर्द्रता ४२%. परिस्थिती पूर्णपणे सुरक्षित.

timeline.narrative: Orographic enhancement causes steady downpours along the crest line. Runoff begins entering Bhushi Dam reservoir.
timeline.narrative_mr: घाटमाथ्यावर पावसाचा जोर वाढला. धरणात पाण्याचा प्रवाह सुरू.

timeline.narrative: Catchment soil saturation crosses 70%. Inclinometer at Amrutanjan slope detects minor micro-strain. Tourist footfall active.
timeline.narrative_mr: पावसाची संततधार. पर्यटकांची गर्दी वाढलेली असताना मातीची संपृक्तता ७०% पार.

timeline.narrative: Sudden cloudburst-like squall hits Tiger Valley catchment (44.5 mm/h). Bhushi Dam waterfall surges abruptly over steps. AI model issues automated flash surge advisory.
timeline.narrative_mr: टायगर व्हॅलीत ढगफुटीसदृश पाऊस. भुशी धरणाच्या पायऱ्यांवर पाण्याचा अचानक प्रचंड लोंढा. मॉडेलकडून तात्काळ इशारा.
active_incidents: Bhushi waterfall surge: Police clear tourists from cascade steps.

timeline.narrative: Antecedent 48h rainfall surpasses 240mm. Basalt overburden on 36° slope loses effective cohesion. Boulder roll detected on Bhor Ghat rail line km 118.
timeline.narrative_mr: ४८ तासांत २४० मिमी पाऊस. मंकी हिल ते ठाकूरवाडी दरम्यान रेल्वे ट्रॅकवर दगड पडले. महामार्गावर वेग मर्यादा लागू.
active_incidents: Thakurwadi rail track rockfall reported; speed restriction enacted.
Patan village committee evacuates upper terrace homes.

timeline.narrative: Rain intensity subsides to 8 mm/h, but saturated slopes remain prone to delayed rotational slump for up to 18 hours. Emergency shelters accommodate 65 evacuated villagers.
timeline.narrative_mr: पाऊस मंदावला तरी डोंगरउतार अजूनही धोकादायक स्थितीत. मदत केंद्रात ग्रामस्थांची सोय.
active_incidents: Road clearance crews active at Bhor Ghat.
